legenda_completa: The same Jason and Lucia club scene, one year apart. The top half is the dancing scene as it appeared in Trailer 2 in 2025. Lucia wears a sequined dress under bright club lighting, with Jason’s hand at her hip, his watch visible. The bottom half is the same scene as it appears in the new pre-load trailer released today, November 10, 2026 — the footage is noticeably darker, with heavier purple and blue neon tones across the same shots. Rockstar Games has now shown this scene in two separate trailers more than a year apart, and the lighting and color grading have clearly changed between the two versions.
